test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which sector is the largest recipient of foreign direct investment in the first half of financial year 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Service sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The service sector in India has been the **largest recipient of foreign direct investment (FDI)** for several years, including the first half of FY 2024-25.
 
• Key areas of investment within the service sector include **IT services, financial services, and telecommunications**, making it a vital contributor to the economy.
 
• The sector accounts for a significant share of India's GDP and employment, contributing approximately **53% to the GDP** in 2023-24 (as per the Economic Survey).
 
• Increased FDI in the service sector is attributed to **liberalized policies, ease of doing business, and India's growing digital infrastructure**.
 
• FDI inflows into the service sector have been bolstered by initiatives like **Digital India and Start-up India**, which attract global investors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI):**

 
 
• It refers to investments made by a foreign entity directly into the economy of another country.
 
• FDI plays a critical role in economic growth, bringing in capital, technology, and expertise.
 
 
 
• **Service Sector in India:**
 
 
• The service sector includes industries such as IT, retail, hospitality, real estate, and healthcare.
 
• India's IT and IT-enabled services (ITeS) sector is one of the largest globally, with major players like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro.
 
 
 
• **Ease of Doing Business:**
 
 
• The Indian government has introduced reforms to improve business conditions, ranking 63rd in the World Bank's 2022 Ease of Doing Business index.
 
• Measures include digitizing processes, reducing red tape, and simplifying taxation.
 
 
 
• **Digital India Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched in 2015, this program aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society.
 
• It has significantly enhanced the service sector by boosting e-governance and digital infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Trends in FDI Inflows:**
 
 
• India received a record $84 billion in FDI in FY 2021-22, with a significant portion directed towards the service sector.
 
• Countries like the USA, Singapore, and Japan are major sources of FDI for India.
